capabilities: Assign matching tags from a user-defined tag list with descriptions
Show confidence scores for each candidate tag before writing
Write tags as inline #tags or into the tags property
Batch-tag all notes in a folder with confirmation and run limits
Suggest a tag list from existing vault tags and folder names
extras: Sends note content (up to 20,000 characters) and your tag list to TypeSafe's US-hosted API on each run; warns about cost limits on folder runs, plain-text API key storage, and backing up before large batch runs. Interface available in English and German.
problem: Manually tagging notes is tedious and inconsistent, and AI taggers often invent tags that break your existing tag system.

relations.evidence: TagSense uses the Jev API by TypeSafe AI.

requires.name: Jev API usage billed by TypeSafe

summary: AI-powered auto-tagging plugin that assigns tags from your own predefined tag list using the Jev model by TypeSafe AI.
